messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — scheduling an RFC sync for tomorrow 10:30am PT. Need to slot three authors and lock reviewers. Authors: @Maria Ruiz, @Ben O'Neill, @Samir Patel. Please confirm preferred slot length (15m or 30m) and whether you need slides or a demo. Pre-reads: https://internal.redwood/docs/rfcs/2026-q2 (skim the TL;DR).

Maria Ruiz: I can do 15m. Slides: 2 slides only. Prefer to go first if possible :hand:

Ben O'Neill: 30m for mine (demo included). Will need audio + screen share. Can't do first — prefer middle slot.

Samir Patel: 15m, no slides. Fine anywhere after Maria. Happy to handle quick follow-ups if time permits.

Julie Park: Proposed agenda order (approx):
```
1) Maria - Autofill KV cache strategy (15m)
2) Ben - Quantization safety checklist + demo (30m)
3) Samir - Routing fallback policy (15m)
Q/A and rollout decisions (10m)
```
If folks agree I'll post this as the meeting agenda and tag reviewers.

Maria Ruiz: Sounds good to me. Can reviewers call out any pre-read questions here? I'll highlight the perf numbers in the slides.

Alex Chen: Reviewers: @Julie Park and @Samir Patel — can you review Maria? Julie yes, Samir can comment but is presenting later. Also tagging @Ben to confirm middle slot ok.

Ben O'Neill: Middle slot confirmed. I'll upload demo snippet to the doc in a bit. ETA ~1h.

Julie Park: I'll read Maria's RFC now and post 2 quick bullets if anything needs clarification. Reminder: let's aim to keep each author to time — I'll nudge if we overrun :clock1:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled — RFC Sync tomorrow 10:20am PT (10 minutes before start). Link: https://meet.redwood/xyz

Samir Patel: Small ask — can we swap order 2 & 3 if Ben needs extra setup time? Ben, if you need >5min setup I'll move you to last and do routing first.

Ben O'Neill: I can have setup done in 3 minutes between speakers. Keep order as Julie proposed.

Alex Chen: Great. Julie, once you post the pre-read bullets I'll send a final agenda. If anyone needs a longer slot, tell me now. Otherwise I'll finalize in 30m.

Julie Park: Posted two bullets in the doc: 1) clarify cache invalidation constraints, 2) verify perf numbers for subsequence workloads. :eyes:

Maria Ruiz: Got them, thanks. I'll update slide 2 to call out invalidation assumptions.

Alex Chen: All set — final agenda will be posted at 10:00am PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
